info.name: AI-Powered Social Media API
info.description:
Complete API for the AI-Powered Social Media Platform.

Select the "Social Media API - Local" environment, then run the whole collection with the Collection Runner (in order). The run registers two fresh test users, exercises every module, and deletes the test data at the end (Cleanup folder).

Requires the development admin account admin@example.com (see docs/API_DOCUMENTATION.md). Tokens are saved automatically: access_token (user), second_token (second user), admin_token (admin).

item.name: 2. Email Verification
item.description: Verification links are emailed (or printed in the server log when SMTP is not configured). Tokens never appear in responses.

request.description: Sends a verification link to the logged-in user. email_delivered=false means SMTP is not configured (link printed in the server log).

exec: const save = (k, v) => { pm.collectionVariables.set(k, v); if (pm.environment.has(k)) pm.environment.set(k, v); };
pm.test('Code valid 10 minutes, resend after 60 s', () => { pm.expect(body.expires_in_seconds).to.eql(600); pm.expect(body.resend_after_seconds).to.eql(60); });
pm.test('Masked email, no code in response', () => { pm.expect(body.email).to.include('***'); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.match(/\b\d{6}\b/); });
